novel.justification: Uniform-in-\(y\) covariate-sectional Hölder regularity is a deliberate, nonstandard primitive condition of this known-design benchmark. It is satisfied by separately smooth normalized conditional-density families, including bounded finite-dimensional exponential tilts with smooth outcome features and Hölder-smooth coefficient maps in the covariates. Such families model covariates changing the weights of stable outcome features uniformly over a compact outcome support; the benchmark does not require mixed derivative bounds.
